**Role objective**
 The Separations \& F\&F Executive will be required to assist the Separations \& F\&F Manager in processing Full \& Final Settlement for exiting employees.

* Managing the F\&F tracker and ensuring that it is updated on a daily basis.
* Coordinating with Global Payroll / Internal HR SPOCs for processing timely F\&F of employees sent to Onsite locations.

Training & Development Lead
description:
**Training \& Development Lead**

**Location:** Noida

**Department:** Human Resources / Quality \& Operations

**Reports To:** HR Manager / dotted line reporting to Head of Quality (QMS)

**Job Purpose**

The Training \& Development Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing an end\-to\-end employee learning framework using the ADDIE model. This role bridges general HR/organizational development and technical competency mapping, ensuring all training processes comply with **ISO 9001:2015 (Clause 7\.2 \- Competence)** standards.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Training Management (ADDIE Model)**

· **Analysis:** Conduct organization\-wide Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across general, HR, soft\-skills, and technical product/process domains.

· **Design \& Development:** Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build structured training modules, SOPs, and On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) frameworks.

· **Implementation:** Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate both internal technical deep\-dives and external certification programs.

· **Evaluation:** Measure training effectiveness post\-30/60 days via performance data, manager sign\-offs, and skill evaluations.

**2\. QMS \& ISO 9001 Governance**

· Maintain and update the organization’s **Training SOP** and centralized QMS documentation.

· Maintain auditor\-ready records, including Skills Matrices, signed attendance logs, training plans, and effectiveness sign\-offs.

· Lead internal and external audit readiness for Clause 7\.2 (Competence, Training, and Awareness).

**3\. Technical \& Operational Competency Mapping**

· Partner with engineering, firmware, hardware, and assembly leads to map technical roles to required skill levels.

· Formalize peer review mechanisms, OJT sign\-offs, and high\-voltage/lab safety training logs.

**4\. Metrics \& Reporting**

· Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Training Completion Rate (\>90%), Training Effectiveness Rate (\>85%), and Skill Gap Reduction.

· Present quarterly training metrics and compliance reports to management during Management Review Meetings (MRM).

**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

· **Experience:** 4–7 years of experience in Learning \& Development (L\&D) or Training, ideally within engineering, electronics, automotive, or tech manufacturing startups.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Placement Co-ordinator
description:
Job Description: Placement Coordinator Company: Pregrad Position: Placement Coordinator Location: On\-site Employment Type: Full\-Time / Internship Experience: Freshers are welcome About Pregrad Pregrad is an industry\-focused learning and career development platform helping students and young professionals become industry\-ready through practical learning, live mentorship, projects, training programs, and placement opportunities. We work closely with students, colleges, training partners, mentors, and companies to create meaningful career opportunities for the next generation of professionals. Role Overview We are looking for a Placement Coordinator who will be responsible for coordinating and managing placement activities between students, colleges, and hiring companies. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and coordination skills, be comfortable interacting with students and corporate representatives, and have a strong interest in campus placements, recruitment, and career development. Key Responsibilities \- Coordinate placement drives, recruitment processes, and hiring activities with colleges and students. \- Act as a point of contact between Pregrad, colleges, students, HR teams, and hiring companies. \- Communicate job openings, eligibility criteria, interview schedules, assessments, and selection updates to students. \- Coordinate with college placement cells and Training \& Placement Officers (TPOs). \- Maintain and regularly update student and candidate databases. \- Shortlist and coordinate candidates based on company requirements and eligibility criteria. \- Schedule assessments, interviews, group discussions, and other recruitment activities. \- Ensure smooth execution of online and offline placement drives. \- Follow up with candidates and companies throughout the recruitment process. \- Maintain accurate records of applications, attendance, selections, offers, and joining status. \- Prepare regular placement reports and status updates. \- Support the business/partnership team in developing relationships with colleges and companies. \- Identify opportunities to improve student participation and placement outcomes. \- Handle student queries and provide timely updates regarding placement activities. Required Skills \- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. \- Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities. \- Good interpersonal and relationship\-management skills. \- Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel and basic documentation. \- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously. \- Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills. \- Professional communication with students, colleges, and corporate stakeholders. \- Ability to work independently as well as within a team. Preferred Qualifications \- Bachelor's degree in any discipline. \- Candidates with experience in placement coordination, HR, recruitment, business development, campus relations, or student engagement will be preferred. \- Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills are encouraged to apply. What You'll Get at Pregrad \- Hands\-on experience in campus recruitment and talent acquisition. \- Exposure to companies, HR professionals, colleges, and senior stakeholders. \- Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced EdTech \& CareerTech environment. \- Direct involvement in building and executing placement programs. \- Opportunity to develop strong professional, communication, and relationship\-management skills. \- Growth opportunities based on performance. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is proactive, responsible, energetic, and highly organized. If you enjoy interacting with people, building relationships, coordinating teams, and helping students discover career opportunities, this role could be a great fit for you. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated CV/resume at: Email: sambhav@pregradcampus.in Contact: 7814128441 Subject: Application for Placement Coordinator — Pregrad
